rca of the issue: Original bug (empty-looking buttons/cards on /pricing and hero) — caused by CSS cascade order: .brut/.brut-sm used the `background:` shorthand which reset background-color, and was defined AFTER .btn-*-ink. Fix applied by main agent (moved .btn-*-ink after .brut + !important) is verified working via getComputedStyle on paid-card / unlock-btn / pricing-chip / cta-unlock — all now report the expected colored backgrounds instead of white/transparent.
